ic_name: IEEE 1588 Precision Time Protocol (PTP) Clock Synchronization Engine (PTPv2 / IEEE 802.1AS)

test_modes.name: 1PPS comparison
test_modes.purpose: Measure the disciplined 1-pulse-per-second against a reference to quantify sync error.

test_modes.name: Master / slave emulation
test_modes.purpose: Drive the node with a PTP master or slave emulator to exercise the message exchange.

test_modes.name: Asymmetry / delay injection
test_modes.purpose: Inject link asymmetry to verify the correction and the servo response.

test_modes.name: BMCA scenario test
test_modes.purpose: Present competing Announce messages to verify Grandmaster election.

spec_provided_observability.name: currentDS (offsetFromMaster / meanPathDelay)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Read the live synchronization error and path delay.

spec_provided_observability.name: parentDS (grandmasterIdentity / stepsRemoved)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Identify the elected Grandmaster and the hop count.

spec_provided_observability.name: Management messages
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Read/write clock data sets for monitoring and configuration.

spec_provided_observability.name: Timestamp capture (T1/T2/T3/T4)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Inspect the raw event-message timestamps and the correctionField.

spec_provided_observability.name: 1PPS / ToD output
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Externally measure the disciplined local time against a reference.

error_detection_mechanisms: announceReceiptTimeout detects loss of the master (re-run BMCA).
Excessive offsetFromMaster indicates servo divergence / asymmetry.
checksum/FCS of the carrier (Ethernet FCS / UDP checksum) detects corruption.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: A port transitions MASTER / SLAVE / PASSIVE.

loopback_modes_summary.name: Near-end MAC loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: MAC TX → MAC RX inside the MAC; PHY not exercised.

loopback_modes_summary.name: PCS loopback (BMCR 0.14)
loopback_modes_summary.scope: MII / GMII TX path → MII / GMII RX path inside the PHY; medium not driven.

loopback_modes_summary.name: PMA / PMD loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: Vendor-specific; loops back on the analog side of the PHY (e.g. after the MLT-3 encoder).

loopback_modes_summary.name: External cable loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: Physical RJ-45 / fiber loopback plug at the MDI; exercises the entire TX + RX analog chain.

notes: PTP's protocol-level test/debug surface is the data sets (currentDS / portDS / parentDS) read via Management messages, the raw T1..T4 timestamps and correctionField, and the 1PPS/ToD output for external measurement. Chip-level JTAG/scan/BIST remain SoC concerns.
